messages.text:
"Create a complete, fully playable 2D survival arena game from a bird's-eye view, with the camera looking straight down at the arena. The player controls a character in a large arena while enemies continuously spawn from all directions and chase the player. The goal is to survive for as long as possible while defeating enemies. The character must be able to move freely in all directions using smooth controls and automatically attack nearby enemies.

There must be exactly ten playable characters. One character is a duck named Dusty, another is a spider named N1co. The remaining eight characters must be different animals or creatures without names. Every character must have their own unique appearance, basic attack, stats, strengths, weaknesses and ultimate ability.

The characters must have the following exact starting stats. Health is measured in HP, damage in damage points, movement speed in speed units and attack speed in attacks per second.

Dusty is a duck with 180 HP, 24 damage, 105 movement speed, 1.2 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. His ultimate is called Tornado Quack. It creates a huge spinning tornado around Dusty that pulls enemies inward and deals 120 damage per second for 5 seconds.

N1co is a spider with 160 HP, 30 damage, 120 movement speed, 1.5 attacks per second and 110 pickup range. His ultimate is called Web Apocalypse. It shoots a massive web in every direction, trapping nearby enemies for 4 seconds and dealing 180 damage.

The fox has 110 HP, 18 damage, 150 movement speed, 1.4 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. Its ultimate is Shadow Dash, which dashes through enemies and deals 100 damage to everything in its path.

The turtle has 220 HP, 12 damage, 75 movement speed, 0.8 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. Its ultimate is Shell Fortress, which makes it temporarily invulnerable for 4 seconds and damages nearby enemies.

The bat has 90 HP, 16 damage, 145 movement speed, 1.8 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. Its ultimate is Sonic Blast, which releases a powerful sound wave that damages and knocks back enemies.

The wolf has 140 HP, 22 damage, 125 movement speed, 1.2 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. Its ultimate is Pack Frenzy, which summons temporary wolf spirits that attack nearby enemies.

The frog has 120 HP, 15 damage, 135 movement speed, 1.3 attacks per second and 125 pickup range. Its ultimate is Toxic Rain, which creates a poisonous area that damages enemies over time.

The penguin has 150 HP, 20 damage, 110 movement speed, 1.1 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. Its ultimate is Ice Storm, which freezes nearby enemies and deals 90 damage.

The bee has 85 HP, 14 damage, 165 movement speed, 2.0 attacks per second and 115 pickup range. Its ultimate is Swarm Attack, which summons a swarm of bees that attacks enemies for 6 seconds.

The crocodile has 170 HP, 26 damage, 90 movement speed, 0.9 attacks per second and 100 pickup range. Its ultimate is Death Bite, which performs a powerful bite that deals 200 damage to enemies in front.

Dusty and N1co must initially be locked. Dusty can be unlocked by defeating 500 enemies in total across all runs. N1co can be unlocked by surviving for 8 minutes in a single run. The other eight characters must be available from the beginning. Dusty and N1co must be the strongest characters overall, with better stats and especially powerful ultimate abilities. They should feel like special reward characters worth working towards.

Whenever an enemy dies, it must drop small glowing green experience stones. These stones appear where the enemy died and remain on the ground until collected. The player collects them by walking over them. Each collected stone gives experience points.

Display the player's health bar in the top right corner of the screen and the XP progress bar directly below it. The health bar must show current and maximum HP. The XP bar must show current experience and the amount required for the next level. When the XP bar becomes full, pause the gameplay completely and display a level-up selection screen.

The player must choose one upgrade from three randomly selected options. Each level must require more experience than the previous level. There must be exactly 50 different possible upgrades, and every upgrade must have a real effect on gameplay.

The available offensive upgrades are Sharp Attacks, which increases damage by 10%. Power Strike, which increases damage by 20%. Deadly Precision, which increases critical hit chance by 15%. Critical Impact, which increases critical damage by 50%. Rapid Fire, which increases attack speed by 15%. Quick Hands, which increases attack speed by 25%. Piercing Shots, which allows attacks to pass through one additional enemy. Double Strike, which gives a 10% chance to attack twice. Explosive Hits, which creates a small explosion dealing 40 damage every tenth attack. Executioner, which increases damage against enemies below 30% health by 20%.

The available defensive upgrades are Tough Skin, which increases maximum health by 15 HP. Iron Body, which increases maximum health by 30 HP. Regeneration, which restores 2 HP per second. Strong Heart, which increases maximum health by 20%. Damage Reduction, which reduces incoming damage by 10%. Last Stand, which increases damage by 30% when below 25% health. Shield, which provides a shield that absorbs 30 damage every 30 seconds. Quick Recovery, which makes healing effects 25% stronger. Boss Protection, which reduces damage received from bosses by 15%. Second Chance, which allows the player to survive one otherwise fatal hit per run with 1 HP and a short protection period.

The available movement upgrades are Swift Feet, which increases movement speed by 10%. Lightning Speed, which increases movement speed by 20%. Long Reach, which increases pickup range by 20%. Magnetic Stones, which increases pickup range by 40%. Quick Escape, which increases movement speed by 15% for 3 seconds after taking damage. Ghost Movement, which allows the player to move through enemies for 2 seconds after activating the ultimate. Agility, which provides a 10% chance to dodge enemy attacks. Momentum, which increases movement speed by 5% for every 30 seconds without taking damage, up to 20%. Jumping Attack, which automatically jumps away from nearby enemies every 15 seconds. Lightweight, which reduces slow effects by 50%.

The available ultimate upgrades are Fast Charging, which increases ultimate charge speed by 15%. Powerful Ultimate, which increases ultimate damage by 20%. Extended Ultimate, which increases ultimate duration by 25%. Energy Boost, which grants 10% ultimate charge whenever a boss is defeated. Quick Recharge, which grants 5% ultimate charge every 10 seconds. Ultimate Explosion, which adds 30 damage to ultimate abilities. Extended Range, which increases ultimate range by 20%. Ultimate Mastery, which increases ultimate damage and charge speed by 10%. Energy Overflow, which allows ultimate charge to exceed 100% and be stored up to 150%. Final Fury, which increases ultimate damage by 40% when the player has less than 30% health.

The available special upgrades are Lucky Drop, which increases XP gained from enemies by 20%. XP Magnet, which automatically collects XP stones within a small radius. Treasure Hunter, which gives enemies a 10% chance to drop extra XP. Boss Slayer, which increases damage against powerful enemies by 25%. Survivor, which restores 1 HP for every 20 enemies defeated. Battle Focus, which increases damage by 10% when fewer than five enemies are nearby. Adrenaline, which increases attack speed by 15% for 5 seconds after defeating a powerful enemy. Overcharge, which grants 20% ultimate charge when reaching a new level. Veteran, which provides 5% temporary damage reduction at the beginning of every new wave. Legendary Growth, which increases all basic stats by 3%.

When the player levels up, the game must pause completely. Display three randomly selected upgrade cards in the middle of the screen. Each card must show the upgrade name, description, icon and exact stat improvement.

On the side of the upgrade selection screen, display a complete character statistics panel. It must show current health, maximum health, damage, attack speed, movement speed, critical hit chance, critical damage, damage reduction, pickup range, ultimate charge speed, ultimate damage, ultimate duration and XP bonus.

All statistics must update dynamically whenever an upgrade is selected. For example, if the player currently has 100 damage and chooses an upgrade that increases damage by 20%, the statistics panel must immediately display 120 damage. The player must be able to compare their current stats before choosing an upgrade.

Every character must have a unique ultimate ability. Each ultimate has its own charge bar that fills when the player damages or defeats enemies. When the charge reaches 100%, the player can activate the ultimate using a clearly visible button. Every ultimate must have its own animations, sound effects and visual effects. Dusty and N1co must have particularly powerful ultimate abilities.

The gameplay screen must display the survival timer and total enemies defeated in the top left corner. The current wave number must be prominently displayed in the middle at the top of the screen. The health and XP bars must be in the top right corner. The ultimate ability button and charge percentage must be in the bottom right corner. The character portrait and current level must be displayed in the bottom left corner.

Create a colorful, polished 2D art style with detailed and recognizable character designs, smooth animations, satisfying attack effects and a visually appealing arena. Enemies must look different from playable characters. XP stones must glow and be easy to see. Include different enemy types with different appearances, health values, movement speeds and attack patterns.

Create a main menu with Play, Character Selection and Statistics. The character selection screen must display all ten characters, their appearances, stats, ultimate abilities and unlock requirements. Include a game-over screen showing survival time, highest wave, enemies defeated and total experience collected. Save unlocked characters and permanent quest progress between runs.

The game must be completely functional and playable, not just a visual prototype. All ten characters, their attacks, all 50 upgrades, the dynamic statistics panel, XP collection, leveling system, character unlocking, health system, ultimate abilities, enemies and menus must work correctly. Do not add an inventory, equipment, weapons shop or collectible items. All progression must revolve around character stats, experience and upgrade choices. Make the gameplay balanced, challenging, smooth and enjoyable.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
